_README: PLACEHOLDER DATA. Replace the hotlines below with verified, region-appropriate crisis resources before release. The keyword list triggers a calm, non-clinical resources screen. This is NOT a diagnostic tool and does not counsel — it only surfaces resources. Keep entries accurate and current; outdated crisis numbers can cause harm.
